data.name: Mustapha
data.long_meaning: My lord has chosen, preferred, loved and annointed. Derived from the trilateral Arabic root 's-t-f', which signifies to choose, to prefer, to elect. In the Quran, Prophet Musa (Moses) is called 'Khaṭṭāb al-Mustafa', meaning 'the Chosen One'.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are chosen by Allah to carry a special mission or duty.
data.numerology_meaning: A number of harmony, love, and balance.
